author: Edge
text:
I love how you analyse winners and losers. Great stuff.... That's the
thing about the FLs. We seem to only know the true FL as it occurs. It
can be hidden right down in the tick chart and if we don't have the data
 what appears as the FL in a slightly HTF may actually be a reaction to
the tiny FL where the decision was to fail and continue. I guess that's
why we have to keep drilling down, unless we have a larger retrace after
 the barrier than failure and continuation. In that case the FL can be
seen on the HTF. Would that be correct?

OK Guys

It is about 8 month that i am living in RTM and enjoyed every second of it. RTM really feel like home for me!

from the first moment i start RTM, i forgot every bullshit that i
studied before, candle sticks, trendlines, channels... and stop trading
 live and put all my time into learning RTM concepts

I Start with the Homeworks, articles and videos. I studied them Step by Step and had plan for each part of my journey yet

Also if you study the RTM from the first pages, start here, everything
has been said there and a complete plan for your trading journey has
been told there

After doing homeworks for about 4-5 months! i went through the journals
and at the same time started trading on a demo account for two months
that i post it's result in the previous pages in my journal, that was a
turning point in my trading style and understanding!

I decided not to trade live until i become more comfortable with the
market and become profitable at least for three months as IF said

I think it worth to reading it again:(
 Resource Link
)

A Note before you begin

To all new traders:

This is a business, a very hard business.Every day we stare into the
abyss, and the abyss stares right back into us.To make our living, we
must daily face the demons Fear and Greed, and win.

Most of us, upon beginning our journey in trading, blew account after
account , trying out any system which was advertised well enough. We
found out that the market could chew us up and spit us out without
giving us a thought. We certainly paid our dues to that which would
provide for us later.

We imagined that we'd get rich quick, and that just didn't happen so easily.

What we had to do was put away all those silly indicators that promised
to give us an edge, and just look at what the charts were showing us.It
took thousands of hours of hard work and dedication to become successful
 traders.

Eventually, we found that price has ways of telling you what it's going
to do next. We began to notice many different patterns and price
structures which indicate that price should move to here or there.

We were no longer looking for an "edge". We just saw the truth of the market - what it wanted to do next.

.

.

.

Begin trading in Demo

I know you're itching to make your millions right away. You will not.
You will not hit the ground running. You will hit the ground rolling and
 stumbling and not knowing where your feet are. Make all your initial
mistakes for free.

Become regularly profitable for three months before you trade
with real money. Every loser can have a winning streak and think he's
cracked the market. You will have winning streaks and losing streaks
along the way. This is part of the learning process. Imagine that you
need a trading license to trade live, and that you must be consistently
profitable for at least three months to earn that license.Don't create
any shortcuts or loopholes. Earn that license fairly and honestly, or
it'll cost you, I promise.

When you've earned your trading license, celebrate. Have a party if you
like. Award yourself the license, either physically or mentally. You'll
need that memory to cling to in the dark times ahead.

When you're ready to trade live, remember this:

Trading live is a world away from trading demo. The emotions you will
feel will be far removed from those you experienced in demo. Sure, you
are ready to read the market, but now is the time to master your
emotions. This may take time. Fear and greed can be as destructive as
those silly systems you left behind.

Successful traders don't just take money magically from the
markets. They take it from PEOPLE. They take it from the 95% of people
who try to trade and fail. Don't let them see YOUR money in the market
until you're one of them.

So as you read above IF advise us not to start trading Live till we become profitable at least for 3 months
